---CRITIQUE Cash-Verified Research Value---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: This is a one-token swap (ib→oancf) of the archived "Realized Research Value" with an identical second leg, i.e., a cosmetic robustness variant rather than a new mechanism, and the cash-flow-yield leg is already present in archived signal #1.

---CRITIQUE Gross Profit Innovation Value---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: Doubly redundant — the valuation leg is the well-documented gross-profits-to-market anomaly (Novy-Marx 2013; Ball et al. 2015), and the full construction is the archived "Persistent Innovation Sales Value" with sale replaced by sale−cogs.

---CRITIQUE Organic Recognition Gap Value---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The organic-vs-acquired intangible distinction is a genuinely interesting angle, but subtracting a stock (gdwl/at, typically 0.1–0.4) from a flow (xrd/at, typically 0.01–0.06) means the "gap" is numerically dominated by goodwill, so the signal collapses toward archived sales-yield × low-goodwill rather than testing the stated recognition asymmetry.

---CRITIQUE Cash-Funded Research Deepening---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: Coherent and internally consistent — it reverses the valuation polarity of the archived "Premium Research Burden" and pairs rising, internally financed R&D with cash-flow yield — though the R&D-increase leg overlaps with the known R&D-increase/Eberhart-Maxwell-Siddique literature and the smoothed DELTA is a slow, low-variance conditioner.

---CRITIQUE Failed Research Premium---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: Because both legs are inverted relative to the archived "Realized Research Value" (price-to-sales instead of yield, NEG(growth) which exactly reverses the rank of R&D×growth), the rank product decomposes to 1−a−b+ab and thus reproduces the archived interaction term with a sign contradicting the stated EXPECTED_SIGN, so it is largely a mechanical mirror plus main effects rather than an isolated failed-commercialization tail.

---CRITIQUE Unstable Innovation Premium---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The sign logic is internally consistent (expensive on EBITDA × unstable R&D → negative) and R&D-policy instability is a reasonably fresh conditioner, but COALESCE(xrd,0) forces all non-reporters to VOL=0, pooling "no R&D" with "perfectly stable R&D" at the bottom rank, and the 5-year window will thin coverage — both should be diagnosed before trusting any result.
